current_flow: sap-ingestion ingests the SAP Base Report (Excel upload) and the MIS budget plan into the separate warehouse Postgres: raw transaction lines retained for drill-down + a monthly gold rollup (Σ(debit−credit) by plant+cost_center+gl+month), budget kept as a separate object joined at query time (decision 0004), idempotent per-period reloads, July DUB reconciling to ₹11,512,712. This requirements grill resolves the spec's seven open ambiguities before decomposition.
gaps: Upload scope vs pilot scope: the workbook is company-wide (31 plants) but the PoC is DUB/July; the spec doesn't say whether ingestion persists the whole workbook or just the pilot slice
Unmapped/ambiguous DUB transaction policy: the 7 missing GLs + contradictory cost-centers mean a straight join silently drops spend; the spec only says keys are normalized 'per the mapping master'

Budget join grain + revision lifecycle: budget is format-line based but must join on (plant,cc,gl,month); no allocation/bridge is defined to prevent fan-out, nor the budget-replace-without-touching-actuals rule
Raw-line identity + replacement provenance: 'retain raw lines' doesn't state the retained fields, stable identity, or whether replacement destroys prior evidence
Reconciliation definition: '≈ ₹1,15,12,712' with no stated comparator leaves the acceptance test non-falsifiable
Excel acceptance + atomic-failure contract: no required headers, posting-date→period rule, malformed handling, or validate-before-replace guarantee; sheet-name vs header-set authority is unstated
Upload authorization + audit: the spec names an 'operator' but not who may load/replace financial periods, despite drill-down requiring RBAC + audit on raw financial lines
resolutions: Accept and retain the FULL July source batch (all plants); only canonical Nursery DUB (DUB-NUR in SAP) is reportable/reconcilable in the PoC; other plants retained-but-unconfigured.
Retain the raw row + original keys, but REJECT the DUB period as unreconciled when any DUB transaction lacks a single provisional mapping (surface count + value); never silently drop or zero it.

The provisional mapping master holds an explicit BALANCED allocation from each MIS budget line to its join keys (each allocation totals back to its source line); budget uploads replace only their (format, canonical plant, period) atomically and never mutate Actuals; rollover retained but not published until its rule is confirmed.

Retain all source + drill fields + original AND canonical keys + transaction-number/line-ID identity + immutable batch metadata; a replacement creates a NEW batch and switches the active batch for the period, never erasing the earlier load record.

Demo-ready reconciliation = exact rupee equality (₹11,512,712) for July 2026 DUB across accepted raw rows, the monthly gold rollup, AND the scoped statement; Srihari's later filled July MIS is a separate, later validation comparator.

Identify the input sheet by its required HEADER set (not its name); require a single posting month per batch; validate ALL rows before writing; reject invalid/mixed-period files with row-level diagnostics and NO change to the active batch.

Restrict uploads and period replacement to a configured data-owner/ingestion-operator role (a new RBAC action grant) and audit uploader, time, source batch, validation result, reconciliation result, and the replaced active batch.
